_comment: PostgreSQL optimizer cost units calibrated with the Wu et al. (ICDE 2013) profiling method. CPU units measured warm (in shared_buffers, no I/O); I/O units measured COLD (real disk reads after `brew services restart` + `sudo purge`). Regenerate with calibration/calibrate_1_cpu_warm.py then calibrate_2_io_cold.py. Applied via env var PG_COST_GUCS=calibrated (see calibration/README.md).
